text.tspan: Lifespan inequality: Gini coefficient in men
The level of inequality in lifespans within a country, measured between 0 and 1. A higher Gini coefficient
indicates greater inequality in ages of death.
Data source: Human Mortality Database (2025); Aburto et al. (2023)
